items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: I noticed the difference between the albums I bought from Louis and the Big Band-Sachen

ctx.x: And you were suddenly very interested in the Jazz? Yeah, very interested. You noticed that was your music?

Yeah. But I noticed the difference between the albums I bought from Louis and the Big Band-Sachen, which I heard in concerts and in radio. And then was also Bill Haley very well. Was that not later? No, no.
